definitions.gloss: settlement of accounts, final calculation, squaring up
definitions.explanation: The act of calculating the exact amount owed and settling the balance, whether for expenses, fares, or shared costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精算|せいさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精算|せいさん}{機|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{不足分|ふそくぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I paid the shortfall at the fare adjustment machine at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{戻|もど}ったら→戻る：01117_modoru⟧、⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{精算|せいさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you return from the business trip, please don't forget to settle your transportation expenses.

notes:
FORMS:
{精|せい} (precise, detailed) + {算|さん} (calculate) = precise calculation.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧ (production, manufacturing) or ⟦{清算|せいさん}→清算：17092_seisan⟧ (liquidation, settling debts/relationships). {精算|せいさん} specifically refers to precise accounting and expense settlement.

COMPOUNDS:
- {精算|せいさん}{機|き}: fare adjustment machine (at train stations)
- {精算|せいさん}{書|しょ}: expense report, settlement statement
- {精算|せいさん}{所|じょ}: fare adjustment window

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精算|せいさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to settle expenses
- ⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精算|せいさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to adjust the fare
- {立替|たてかえ}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{精算|せいさん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to settle the amount advanced
